content.example: I'll read the file before answering.

arguments.description: Already deserialized; the engine dispatches to the tool by `name`.

estimated.description: `true` when the provider did not return a count and the cost was ESTIMATED. The number is worth less, and whoever consumes it needs to be able to say so.

error.description: The provider's failure. Comes in the BODY with 200, not as an HTTP error, because the accounting in `usage` remains valid — the turn spent, even while failing.

modelName.description: Name of the model that generated the response (finding from problem 2) — `null` when the turn failed before resolving a model (no binding, or binding to a non-existent model).

toolRouting.description: The step where the Jev chose the tool (ADR 0179, RN-625). Absent when the router was not consulted (provider other than OpenRouter, fewer than two tools, workspace switch off). The engine narrates it as `tool_router.decided`.

ofertadas.description: How many tools the agent had at this step.

menuAntes.description: The tool names BEFORE the router.

menuDepois.description: The tool names the chat model was offered (the whole catalog on any fall).

anterior.description: The previous tool of the same run.

aplicado.description: The Jev answered AND the menu came out smaller than the catalog.

custoMicros.description: REAL cost of the Jev answer (`usage.cost`), in micro-USD.

gastoNaoRegistrado.description: `true` when the Jev charged but the `token_usage` row could not be written.

403.description: Budget exceeded with `policy=block`, or invalid service token.

404.description: Session, project, or resource not found.
